text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What are your favorite okonomiyaki
fillings?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'd say mine are... shrimp, squid,
scallops... You
know, the one with
everything—the "special"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's so extravagant with all that stuff in it!
Just
thinking about it makes you the
happiest, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Some of my friends think I'm just simple
to
please... But it's good, isn't it? And so

extravagant...
